text: Theo writes this document after the Lesson 24 drill, not before it, so it describes proven behavior instead of intended behavior — including the one honest finding, the RTO margin, rather than a clean-sounding document that quietly omits it.

One reference document, six sections: architecture overview, the FinOps dashboard, incident history, hardening changes, the validation record, and ownership — who maintains each part going forward, not just who wrote it once.

The document lives in the same repository as the Terraform modules and Kubernetes manifests, in a docs/platform/ directory, so a pull request that changes the ceiling or the spread constraint is expected to update the relevant section in the same diff.

Each section names a real owner, and the validation record appends new drill results rather than overwriting them, keeping a genuine history instead of one permanently current snapshot that quietly goes stale.
